name: integrations-showcase
title: Integrations Showcase
description: A searchable directory section for showing product integrations with their category and optional explanatory copy. It accepts a title and integration items with stable ids, names, categories, and descriptions; visitors can filter by any of those text fields. Use it when integration fit is an important product question, rather than presenting a decorative wall of logos with no labels or context.
docs: Requires `cn` at `@/lib/utils`. Integration content is provided locally; if consumers link items to setup flows, provide explicit links as a future extension rather than implying the cards are interactive.

meta.engineeringNotes: Uses a native search input and client-side filtering over caller-provided data, avoiding a remote search dependency for a small marketing catalog. The result count is announced through one polite live region, while a visible empty state explains how to recover from no matches. Each result names both the integration and its category so meaning does not depend on a logo.
meta.motionNotes: Filtering updates the list immediately without stagger or layout animation; visitors need a quick and stable response to each query. Result count and empty-state copy provide feedback without movement. Reduced-motion preferences require no special fallback because no animation is introduced.
